name: bid-battle
description: Bid Battle - a multiplayer market-making card game prototype

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @bid-battle/server" "npm run dev -w @bid-battle/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bid-battle/engine && npm run build -w @bid-battle/server && npm run build -w @bid-battle/web
